outcome: no arm passed the registered screen
interpretation: Focal loss improved ECE slightly relative to the unchanged parent but did not improve threshold coverage or AURC. Lower ECE alone is not sufficient for promotion.

Label smoothing slightly improved accuracy while substantially worsening confidence ordering. Paired development AURC delta versus parent is +0.0422 with 95% interval [0.0228, 0.0651], where larger AURC is worse.
Ordinary continued training also reduced selective performance. A released-parent-only comparison would fail to isolate this effect.
This is one 4B seed, one epoch, one data mixture and one setting per loss, not proof that these losses never work.
No result justified replication under the registered gate. The fresh threshold and final partitions remain unscored. No fallback candidate was selected from historical test results.
larger_model_decision: No scale-up justified by this screen. Keep PLAN_27b as a separate gated proposal; audit or targeted data experiments need a new registered hypothesis before more training.

budget.caveat: Workspace billing can lag and includes startup/storage or unrelated workspace activity; this is not an exact invoice for each individual trial.
